name: @post/e2e-assets
description: Asset hub e2e (T0709 required test "asset ui e2e"): real Chromium drives the built web app through /assets and one asset's page — the eleven items of docs/42 §Asset Page, the four-type filter, the one not-found state, and the absence of any blob download control — while the API is mocked at the network layer with the exact wire shapes cmd/api/assetshttp + internal/assets.BuildPage produce (the Go handler suite and the integration suite lock those shapes against a real guard and real PostgreSQL).
